sources.title: clip-vit-base-patch32 - Antfly Models
sources.snippet: This model uses the ViT-B/32 architecture (Vision Transformer base with 32x32 patches). CLIP embeddings allow you to search images using natural language queries, or find similar images based on visual content - all through the same vector space.

sources.title: openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 · CLIP — the foundation of mobile vision ...
sources.snippet: CLIP is the model that made mobile multimodal AI possible. Without CLIP, there's no "point camera at object and get description." On Snapdragon 865, CLIP ViT-B/32 processes images in ~50ms. Combined with a tiny LLM (0.5B), you get a full multimodal pipeline that runs on a phone.
